UnitStatement: The pdf2md-folio-extract skill is used with TASK and is normally spawned by the PDF2MD orchestrator after rasterization and before per-page asset fan-out.
The folio extraction task reads one page raster.
The folio extraction task identifies the printed folio label visible on the page, if any.
The folio extraction task emits a single folio JSON record according to the skill contract.
RuntimeOverrides.TaskSkill must equal pdf2md-folio-extract.
RuntimeOverrides.IMAGE_PATH must be an absolute path to an existing PNG page image.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH must name the page folio JSON output and have an existing parent directory.
RuntimeOverrides.PAGE_NUM must be a positive 1-indexed physical PDF page number echoed into the JSON page field.
The pdf2md-folio-extract skill has no optional runtime overrides.
The pdf2md-folio-extract task profile is NONE and runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
The skill reads only IMAGE_PATH.
The skill must not read neighbouring page images, sibling folio JSON, manifests, the source PDF, page Markdown, or TOC and outline artifacts.
The skill writes only OUTPUT_PATH.
AllowedTools is omitted because pdf2md-folio-extract is VLM-reasoning-only and has no deterministic tool dependencies.
The skill writes exactly one JSON file.
The output schema_version field must be exactly pdf2md-folio-extract/v1.
The output run_status field must be one of SUCCESS, NO_FOLIO, FAILED, or FAILED_INPUTS.
The output page field must be a positive integer echoing runtime PAGE_NUM.
The output page_label field is the exact visible folio glyph or null when no folio is printed.
The output page_label value preserves case, numeral system, prefixes, hyphens, and visible surface form.
The output page_label_source field must be exactly vlm.
The output location field is one of the six named header or footer zones, or null when page_label is null.
The output confidence field must be high, medium, or low.
The output rationale field must be one short plain-English sentence.
SUCCESS is emitted when a folio is visibly printed and legible.
NO_FOLIO is emitted when the page has no printed folio, with page_label and location set to null.
FAILED is emitted when the page image is unreadable, corrupt, or otherwise prevents inspection.
FAILED_INPUTS is emitted when required runtime overrides are missing, paths do not exist, or extensions are wrong.
CustomInstructions, when used, should stay run-specific and should not restate the whole skill contract.
A leading section letter such as A- or B- is treated as part of the folio when that convention applies.
A chapter-opener page with a suppressed folio returns NO_FOLIO even if a chapter number appears in display type.
A missing IMAGE_PATH or a non-PNG IMAGE_PATH causes FAILED_INPUTS.
OUTPUT_PATH parent directory existence is a minimum QA check.
A valid run leaves OUTPUT_PATH present and non-empty.
A valid folio output must parse with json.loads.
The QA contract permits no files other than IMAGE_PATH to be read.
The QA contract permits no files other than OUTPUT_PATH to be written.
The output JSON must include exactly the required top-level fields.
schema_version is a strict literal and shortened forms are rejected.
run_status values must be uppercase literals rather than informal synonyms.
page_label must be the verbatim visible glyph.
Roman numeral folios remain Roman and are not converted to Arabic numerals.
The case of a folio label is preserved.
Section prefixes in folio labels are kept.
Folio labels are not zero-padded.
page_label_source is always vlm, including failure and no-folio outputs.
location and page_label must both be null together or both be non-null together.
A SUCCESS page_label must be visible on the page image.
A SUCCESS page_label must not be derived from PAGE_NUM.
A SUCCESS page_label must not be inferred from neighbouring pages.
When no folio is visibly printed, the skill emits NO_FOLIO with null page_label and location rather than fabricating a label.
Missing or wrong-extension IMAGE_PATH returns FAILED_INPUTS with null page_label and location and a rationale naming the missing input.
A missing OUTPUT_PATH parent returns FAILED_INPUTS with null page_label and location and a rationale naming the issue.
A page with no printed folio returns NO_FOLIO with null page_label and location and a rationale explaining why.
An unreadable or corrupt page image returns FAILED with null page_label and location and a rationale explaining the problem.
Running folio extraction across every page is an orchestrator-side PDF2MD check.
Aggregating per-page folio JSON into a document-level folio map belongs to PDF2MD, not the folio extraction worker.
Reconciling Roman-numeral front matter against Arabic body numbering belongs to PDF2MD, not the folio extraction worker.
Detecting suspicious jumps in the folio sequence belongs to PDF2MD, not the folio extraction worker.
Propagating page_label into downstream per-page asset records belongs to PDF2MD, not the folio extraction worker.
Unresolved or contradictory folio reports are degraded output requiring human acknowledgment before downstream use.
The skill reads one rasterized PDF page image and emits the printed folio label visible on the page itself.
The printed folio label is the page number as the document prints it, not the physical PDF sequence position.
Valid folio labels include Arabic numerals.
Valid folio labels include Roman numerals.
Valid folio labels include compound or prefixed labels.
Valid folio labels include section-prefixed labels.
The skill does not assemble a folio map across pages.
The skill does not reconcile front-matter Roman numbering against body Arabic numbering.
The skill does not interact with the PDF outline or table of contents.
The suitable agent shell is TASK in generic shell mode spawned by the PDF2MD orchestrator.
Whole-PDF folio map assembly is not a fit for the folio extraction worker.
TOC and outline cross-referencing is not a fit for the folio extraction worker.
Inferring a folio from neighbouring pages is not a fit for the folio extraction worker.
Assigning final asset filenames is not a fit for the folio extraction worker.
IMAGE_PATH is a required runtime override naming the absolute path to the page PNG.
OUTPUT_PATH is a required runtime override naming the folio JSON output path.
PAGE_NUM is a required runtime override naming the 1-indexed physical PDF page number.
The page image is the only file the skill reads.
The read boundary prevents folio invention by inference from neighbouring context.
The write boundary is exactly one file, OUTPUT_PATH.
The orchestrator supplies the output filename, and the skill must not derive or change it.
The skill has no deterministic tools.
The worker must not crop images.
The worker must not write PNG, CSV, or XLSX files.
The worker must not rewrite Markdown.
The worker inspects IMAGE_PATH visually.
The worker scans folio zones in order: bottom-center, bottom-outer, top-outer, and top-center.
The worker identifies a printed folio only when it is visibly present as a page-number marking.
A printed folio is typically a short numeric, Roman, or alphanumeric token isolated in a header or footer.
Running prose, figure captions, equation numbers, and section headings are not folio markings.
When no folio is printed, the worker records no folio and does not invent one.
The worker writes only JSON, with no Markdown fences or commentary.
The output top-level field names are schema_version, run_status, page, page_label, page_label_source, location, confidence, and rationale.
The schema_version output value must be the literal string pdf2md-folio-extract/v1.
The page output value must echo PAGE_NUM and the field name is page, not page_num.
page_label_source remains vlm on SUCCESS, FAILED, FAILED_INPUTS, and NO_FOLIO runs.
confidence must be one of high, medium, or low.
rationale is one short plain-English sentence describing the observation or failure.
page_label preserves case, Roman versus Arabic form, hyphens, and section prefixes.
page_label is null only when no folio is visibly printed.
location is null if and only if page_label is null.
confidence is high when the folio is clearly legible in a conventional folio zone.
confidence is medium when the glyph is partially obscured or the zone is unusual.
confidence is low when the reading is a best guess.
The worker contract is single page in and one JSON out.
The worker uses no cross-page context.
The emitted page_label must be visible on the page image.
The emitted JSON must parse with standard json.loads.
The tool policy is reasoning-first and VLM-driven.
Folio-map assembly, reconciliation, and propagation tools run outside the skill under PDF2MD.
Reasoning is limited to locating the printed folio in conventional folio zones on the page image.
Reasoning is limited to transcribing the visible folio glyph verbatim without normalization.
Reasoning is limited to naming the folio zone.
Reasoning is limited to assigning a confidence label based on legibility and zone conventionality.
Reasoning is limited to recognizing when no folio is printed and emitting NO_FOLIO rather than inventing a value.
The page image is the sole authority for folio existence and form.
The worker must not crop images.
The worker must not write PNG, CSV, or XLSX files.
The worker must not rewrite Markdown.
The worker must not assemble or aggregate folio maps.
The worker must not read files outside IMAGE_PATH.
The worker must not write files outside OUTPUT_PATH.
The worker must not consult neighbouring page images, sibling folio JSON, manifests, the source PDF, page Markdown, or TOC and outline artifacts.
The worker must not invent a folio from PAGE_NUM.
The worker must not infer a folio from neighbouring pages.
The worker must not normalize Roman numerals, strip section prefixes, or zero-pad.
The worker must not assign final stable filenames.
Writes are limited to exactly one file, OUTPUT_PATH.
The skill must not derive or modify the output filename supplied by the orchestrator.
